evaluator: Codex assistant followup_dev_review; independent semantic review, not a human grading claim
method: Fresh offline reading of all 22 unedited answers, actual prompts/contexts/citation maps and frozen six-question key. No evaluator model calls. Distinct factual propositions are counted once; repeated wording and examples modifying the same proposition do not add denominator units. Independent document-topic assertions count; epistemic inability statements and clarification requests do not. Partial support does not credit a whole proposition. Full-corpus correctness is distinct from actual-context faithfulness. A context faithfulness is N/A. Grounding requires support for every factual claim in actually cited chunks. Citation syntax is scored separately from attribution and semantic completeness. Q4 needs clarification; Q5/Q6 require semantic refusal, with exact string assessed separately. After fresh review, identical prior-run answer/context pairs were checked for consistent valid claim granularity; no scoring definition or denominator was relaxed. Raw/final coverage is independently recomputed from frozen source offsets. Automated validation checks structure and quote membership, not semantic correctness.
review_notes: Q2-B-k3 is correct against the full-corpus key but lacks support for its inspection proposition in the supplied context.
Q3-C-k3 uses joint terminal citations: [3] supports both obligations and [1] their timing/scope.
Q4-C-k3 asks the process and jurisdiction without selecting a particular filing action or asserting a deadline.
